layer2.mapping: F_t maps to a cumulative distribution function over season-end outcomes in GSI.
layer2.telemetry: Betting market consensus on long-term outcomes.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators form a triadic structure: matchup tensors encode pairwise game likelihoods, player kernels model individual stochastic outcomes, and futures chains project temporal evolution. These map into a Bayesian belief network where each node represents a probabilistic assertion about game state. Dualities emerge in how odds and props both encode uncertainty—odds through market consensus, props through player performance. Failure modes include overfitting to historical data in props, collapse of odds when markets become illiquid, and temporal drift in futures. The system must maintain coherence across these layers while respecting causality and information flow.
